title: Project Manifest
description: Standard manifest for creature-workshop projects consumed by shellops scripts.

description.description: One-line summary of the project's purpose. Used for agent-assisted triage routing.

latest.description: The release name the tree records: on the default branch the version and its certification with no count (0.67.0-dev), on a record off it the tag's name (0.67.0-6.rc), and a version alone on a stable record. A release writes it to the lock, .ops/lock; a repository that has not converted still carries it here.

stable.description: The last clean release. A release writes it to the lock, .ops/lock; a repository that has not converted still carries it here.

naming.description: Optional names for the version lines, which a release's title carries after the version: the current major's and the current minor's. A repository that names none titles a release by its version alone.

major.description: Name for the current major version era.

minor.description: Name for the current minor version focus.

patch.description: Deprecated. Patch titles are now derived from the tagged commit subject.

ecosystems.description: The ecosystems this repository is written in, declared once (ADR 000006), keyed by ecosystem id. Each id's block is described by the ecosystem's own fragment beside its module (lib/<id>/ecosystem.schema.json); this block mirrors that composition, so an id with no fragment is rejected. Registries that select by ecosystem read this, and a release syncs every version file the declared ecosystems name.
